text: Accepts a reference video as a file, a phone recording, or a YouTube link, plus a description of what you want to make
quote: Just drop it into ReelMimic. A file, a phone recording or a YouTube link all work. Then tell it what you want to make.

text: Analyzes the reference video's shot count, shot lengths, BPM, transitions, colors, framing and camera moves
quote: Breaks down the reference. Shot count, shot lengths, BPM, transitions, colors, framing and camera moves.

text: Shows a plan before production (storyboard, characters, assets, style frames) that you refine in chat and then approve
quote: Shows you the plan first. Storyboard, characters, assets and a few style frames. Chat about it until you like it, then approve.

text: Request changes in a chat panel, including by sending screenshots
quote: If you want changes, say so in the chat on the right. Screenshots work too.

text: Up to 6 agents build different parts of a video in parallel, and a separate agent reviews each finished shot
quote: Up to 6 work on different parts of the video. Each finished shot goes to a new agent for review, so nobody grades their own work.

text: Concurrency is configurable: agents per video (default 6) and a limit across all projects (default 12)
quote: BUILDERS, MAX_AGENTS — How many agents work on one video at once (default 6), and the limit across all projects (default 12)

text: Every fix needs before-and-after screenshots, and the reviewer agent checks them
quote: Fixes need proof. Every fix comes with before and after screenshots, and the reviewer checks them.

text: Shows each agent's reasoning, the commands it ran, the frames it inspected, and a full log
quote: You can see what it's doing. What each agent is thinking, what it ran, which frames it looked at. The full log is there too.

text: Production line tab tracks the status of each character and video part, with review screenshots
quote: The Production line tab shows where each character and each part of the video is, with the review screenshots.

text: Leave timestamped comments at any second of the finished video and submit them as one batch
quote: Comment right on the video. When it's done, scrub to any second and type a note. Send them all at once.

text: Add new styles as Markdown files, one per style, with no code
quote: New styles are just Markdown. One file per style, no code.

text: Extensible with new styles, new rendering engines, or another AI backend
quote: Extending: adding styles, rendering engines, or another AI

text: Seven 2D drawing engines: vector/motion graphics, watercolor, crayon picture book, pixel art, paper cut-out, whiteboard doodle, anime cel
quote: 2D only, seven drawing engines: vector / motion graphics..., hand-painted watercolor..., crayon picture book, pixel art, paper cut-out stop-motion, whiteboard doodle, and anime cel.

text: If a reference doesn't match a known style, it uses the closest engine and writes a proposal for a new style
quote: When a reference doesn't match a known style, it uses the closest engine and writes up a proposal for a new style.

text: Runs entirely on your own computer, using your own Claude Code or Codex
quote: The whole thing runs on your own computer, with your own Claude Code or Codex.

text: Choose Claude Code or Codex as the agent backend when starting a project
quote: On the home page, drop in a reference video or paste a link, say what you want, and pick Claude Code or Codex.

text: If a usage limit is hit, the job pauses and can resume from where it stopped
quote: If you hit a limit, the job pauses and can pick up where it stopped.

text: Install script checks your setup and reports anything missing; re-run any time with npm run doctor
quote: The install script checks your setup and tells you if anything's missing. You can run the check again any time with `cd app && npm run doctor`.

text: Re-check agent availability on demand from the agent pill in the header
quote: Click the agent pill in the header to re-check now.

text: Narration with Yating Taiwanese Mandarin voices, or optional ElevenLabs text-to-speech
quote: YATING_KEY: Yating's Taiwanese Mandarin voices, for narration. ELEVENLABS_API_KEY: Optional ElevenLabs TTS

text: Pulls in licensed images, music and sound effects from optional sources; Openverse works without a key
quote: More images, music and sound effects you're allowed to use (optional, Openverse works without a key)

text: Characters are original by default, or follow your own designs if you provide them
quote: Characters are original unless you bring your own designs, in which case it follows yours.

text: Schedule posting of a finished video to TikTok at a set time and timezone from the command line
quote: npm run post-video -- <project id> --platforms tiktok --at 2026-10-05T18:00 --tz Europe/Madrid --send

text: Post to TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, with a dry-run mode that shows what would be posted
quote: npm run post-video -- <project id> --platforms tiktok,instagram,youtube # dry run: shows what it would post

text: Logs the source, author and license of any asset found online, and flags unclear licenses
quote: Anything it finds online gets logged with its source, author and license. Unclear licenses are flagged.

text: Interface in Traditional Chinese, English and Simplified Chinese, switchable in the top right
quote: Three languages. 繁體中文, English and 简体中文, switch in the top right.
